mapping.summary: Lets users add their own fields to master data and documents without a developer.
claims: Fields can be added to customers, vendors, contacts, projects, items and resources
Fields also work on sales and purchase document headers and lines
Free tier allows five fields per field type per entity
Pro tier raises the limit to ten fields per field type per entity
Each field gets a data type and can use a configurable value list
Custom field values stay in sync between contact, customer and vendor records
Values flow from customers, vendors and items onto projects and sales and purchase documents
Pro tier covers service items and documents, project tasks, production orders, fixed assets and lot/serial info
Custom fields are exposed through APIs
Lookup fields can point to other BC tables
Calculated fields can count, sum, average or divide data
Calculated values can be shown as factbox fields or cues on pages
Role center headlines can include clickable calculated values
